response.description: Azure Site Recovery now supports replication and disaster recovery for Windows Azure Virtual Machines running on NVMe-enabled Generation 2 VM families, such as the Da/Ea/Fa v6-series, Ddsv6, Edsv6 and Ebsv5/Ebdsv5 in the Azure-to-Azure scenario. This enhancement allows customers to enable disaster recovery for their Azure VMs running high performance, I/O-intensive workloads (limited to ASR churn support) with the NVMe disk controller. This capability is supported across all Azure public cloud regions.Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure Site Recovery support for Windows Azure VMs with NVMe disk controllers
